mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recognition_record (user_id, image_path, status, identity_id, confidence, heatmap_path, type, operation_status, individual_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{imagePath}, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{identityId}, #{confidence}, #{heatmapPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operationStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{individualId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE recognition_record SET status = #{status}, identity_id = #{identityId}, confidence = #{confidence}, heatmap_path = #{heatmapPath}, individual_id = #{individualId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
